data.name: HASHIRU
data.detailed_description:
SOMEWHERE IN YOUR MIND—

Working hard every single day wears you down. At first, it feels manageable. Then it tightens, dragging behind you, growing heavier with every step.

You’d think dreams would be an escape.

They aren’t.

With insomnia, nothing feels real. You’re never fully asleep, yet never truly awake. Your dreams twist into something too vivid to trust. You can’t tell what’s right or wrong… whether you’re waking up, or falling deeper.

And anxiety is always there.

Watching. Waiting.

ABOUT THE GAME

Play as Alexei, a man who suffers with insomnia. When he finally drifts off, he becomes trapped inside a series of unstable dreams shaped by his own thoughts and fears. Don't get too attached to your dreams. don't enjoy them more than real life. or the consequences will be unforgettable.

This is a first-person psychological puzzle and movement game where you must navigate surreal environments, solve puzzles, and escape before your mind collapses in on itself.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • First-Person Exploration
    Experience the world directly through Alexei’s eyes as reality shifts around you.

  • Mind-Bending Puzzles
    Use logic, observation, and your own perception to solve increasingly complex challenges.

  • Fast-Paced Movement & Agility
    Run, jump, and react quickly to traverse unstable dream environments and avoid falling behind.

  • Dynamic Dream Environments
    Explore distorted locations pulled from memory, including a fractured city that constantly changes.

  • Psychological Horror Elements
    Encounter manifestations of anxiety that follow, pressure, and distort your decisions.

OBJECTIVE

Escape the dream.

Stay focused. Keep moving. Think clearly.

Because if you wake up too soon…

you may never be able to sleep again.

YOU MAKE THE DIFFERENCE.

Your mind is unpredictable. Unforgiving.

That falling feeling. That sudden jolt before waking.

Here… it doesn’t fade.

Insomnia doesn’t stop you from sleeping.

It convinces you that you can’t.

So let go.

Let your thoughts drift.

And hope you find your way out.

Original Soundtrack By Archer Angel

data.short_description: A game about exploring your own mind. Escape the harsh world of stress and anxiety, solve puzzles, explore more about yourself, figure out your own consciousness. But most importantly - don't get too attached. After all, it's just a dream.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game is actually built to look old and stylised. so as long as you aren't on a literal toaster you will be fine.
